name: Unicode Emoji 16.0 (emoji-test.txt)
note: The emoji standard itself, and one of the few authoritative sources that is properly
versioned: `Public/emoji/16.0/` is immutable, because Unicode publishes a new
directory per release rather than editing the last one in place. No mirror needed and
no serial to ignore -- the contrast with IANA's daily-regenerated root zone file is
the whole reason that one needed `ignoreLinesMatching`.
`emoji-test.txt` carries the group and subgroup taxonomy alongside each sequence,
which is what makes the per-category paths reproducible rather than hand-assigned.
